desc:
🌾ThamNa🌾

🌱 Grow 5 authentic Thai rice varieties, then dry, mill and sell your harvest!
🍌 Plant sugarcane, bananas and papayas to grow your farm business!
✨ Hunt for rare special varieties and Gold, Diamond & Rainbow mutations!
🐔 Raise chickens for fresh eggs and turn their droppings into fertilizer!
🎣 Go fishing and throw a cast net in the ponds!
📈 Watch the live market prices and sell at the right time!
🥷 Sneak ripe bananas and papayas from other farms, or chase thieves away with a slingshot!
🏡 Build and expand your very own Thai farm!

👍 Like and Favorite the game to stay up to date with new updates!
